mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.5% indicates an ultra-accommodative monetary policy that reduces the risk-free rate and increases the relative attractiveness of equities, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward rank IC of FEDFUNDS (with threshold FEDFUNDS<=0.5%) with 20-day forward returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 8.5% signals an impending recession, causing risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The positive 5-day return rate in months with UNRATE > 8.5% is greater than 40%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals stagflation, which increases equity risk and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The positive 20-day return rate in instances where INDPRO < 95 and CPIAUCSL > 212.5 is greater than 40%.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-recession recovery regime (defined by UNRATE < 7.5% and INDPRO > 90), a rising CPIAUCSL (above 212) signals a strengthening economy and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The positive 20-day return rate in the subset where UNRATE < 7.5%, INDPRO > 90, and CPIAUCSL > 212 is less than 60%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 500 thousand units signals a strengthening consumer sector and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days (approximately one quarter).
failure_condition: The positive 60-day return rate in months with HOUST > 500 is less than 60%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in retail sales (RSAFS) above 330,000 thousand dollars signals a strengthening consumer sector and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The positive 60-day return rate in months with RSAFS > 330000 is less than 60%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a deteriorating labor market, causing risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The positive 5-day return rate in instances where PAYEMS < 132000 and UNRATE > 8.5 is greater than 40%.

mechanism_narrative: In the industrial expansion regime (INDPRO > 95), a rising INDPRO (above 95) signals a strengthening manufacturing sector and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The positive 60-day return rate in the industrial expansion regime (INDPRO > 95) is less than 60%.
